verdict.rationale: Trivy is CLI-first and easily wired into CI/CD pipelines for unattended, exit-code-gated scans, and it now ships an official MCP server that lets an AI agent invoke scans and natural-language queries programmatically. However, there is no evidence of a built-in scheduler, daemon mode, or webhook/event-triggered background automation independent of an external CI system. missing for 10: native cron/daemon or scheduled background execution, evidence of the MCP server or CLI running truly autonomously without an external CI trigger, and independent corroboration of unattended long-running automation.
